Those little chips along the edge of your tub aren't just an eyesore. Left alone, they can get worse over time. 🛠️ The good news is you don't need a full tear-out to fix it. Bathtub refinishing repairs chips, cracks, and worn spots right in your home, then tub reglazing adds a smooth, glossy finish that makes the whole tub look new again. Homeowners around Winston Salem choose this route because it's faster and far more affordable than replacement, and most projects wrap up in about a day. If your shower walls have seen better days too, our shower refinishing service can refresh the entire space at once. What refinishing takes care of: • Chips and edge damage • Stains and dull, worn surfaces • Outdated colors that drag the room down As we head into fall, it's a smart time to handle those bathroom repairs before the busy holiday season.
